latestVersion.changelog:
cron-mastery 1.0.0 – Mastering reliable timing and reminders in OpenClaw.

- Introduces guidance on using Cron for precise scheduling versus Heartbeat for casual polling.
- Explains patterns for setting up reliable reminders and system maintenance with auto-cleanup of jobs.
- Clarifies correct usage of payloads for push notifications (AgentTurn) versus silent logs (systemEvent).
- Provides updated best practices for timezone handling and migration from legacy scheduling formats.
- Details troubleshooting steps and reinforced rules for session targeting and self-wake behavior.
